title: utricularia dichotoma subsp. novae-zelandiae
intro: Utricularia dichotoma subsp. novae-zelandiae, commonly known as the New Zealand bladderwort, is a carnivorous plant native to New Zealand. It belongs to the bladderwort family and is known for its unique ability to capture and digest small insects using bladder-like traps. The New Zealand bladderwort has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and the treatment of infections. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
